summary: Full E2E validation of iteration 208 (5 Manager-shell gaps). BACKEND (pytest, 3/3 PASS): (1) legacy bulk-tier-update payload with NO per-product override keys still applies top-level trade_discount/credit_back_rate/disabled to every row — verified by GET round-trip. (2) Per-product override on row-0 (trade_discount=10 + disabled=True) WINS over top-level defaults (5% / disabled=False) — verified by GET; other rows keep global 5%. (3) Partial override (credit_back_rate only) — override wins for that field, other fields inherit top-level. Cleanup restores originals. FRONTEND (Playwright, all 5 P0/P1 items PASS): (P0-1) /admin/materials → 3 selected → Tier Pricing modal shows per-product-overrides-panel with 3 override-row-{sku} rows; entering '10' in override-trade + checking override-disable updates the amber badge to '1 customised'. (P0-2) /admin/supplier-products → select 3 → ManagerTabsBar Materials link renders as '/admin/materials?ids=<encoded-key1>,...&mode=bulk' and shows a +47 counter chip; navigation lands on /admin/materials and fires the correct info toast ('None of the 47 selected products belong to Materials Manager') because seeded TEST_ SKUs are not materials-classified — the fallback branch works as spec'd. (P0-3) On /admin/materials, ticking 3 rows survives page reload (F5) — bulk bar still reads '3 selected' after networkidle. (P0-3b) localStorage buckets are ISOLATED: managerBulk:tiles:selected and managerBulk:materials:selected hold different JSON arrays — no cross-bleed. (P1 Sale/Labels) bar-sale-labels button visible on ManagerBulkBar; click opens BulkSaleModal with title 'Bulk Sale & Labels (3 products)'. (P1 Made In) /admin/materials Edit modal → materials-edit-made_in is a <SELECT> with 12 <option>s (placeholder '— select —' + 11 spec'd countries: Italy, Spain, Portugal, Poland, Turkey, India, Vietnam, China, UK, Europe, Other).

ui_bugs.issue: Pre-existing React 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' console warning — carried over from iteration 206/207.

Backend: Per-product overrides (trade_discount=10, disabled=True) win over top-level defaults (5% / False) for that row only; other rows inherit top-level. ✅
Backend: Partial per-product override (credit_back_rate only) — override wins for that field; other fields inherit top-level defaults. ✅

Frontend P0-1: TierPricingModal renders per-product-overrides-panel + toggle + override-row-{sku} + override-trade-{sku} + override-credit-{sku} + override-disable-{sku}. Badge updates ('1 customised') on edit. ✅
Frontend P0-2: ManagerTabsBar appends '?ids=<encoded-keys>&mode=bulk' to non-active tab hrefs when selectionKeys are present. Also shows +N counter chip on non-active tabs. ✅
Frontend P0-2: Landing on /admin/materials with ?ids= param fires the correct info toast when none of the selected keys match this manager (data-classification fallback). ✅
Frontend P0-3: F5 reload preserves 3-item selection via managerBulk:materials:selected localStorage bucket. ✅
Frontend P0-3b: managerBulk:tiles:selected and managerBulk:materials:selected are isolated — different SKU arrays, no cross-bleed. ✅
Frontend P1 Sale/Labels: bar-sale-labels visible in ManagerBulkBar; opens BulkSaleModal with correct '(N products)' count in title. ✅
Frontend P1 Made In: materials-edit-made_in is <SELECT> with placeholder + 11 country options (Italy, Spain, Portugal, Poland, Turkey, India, Vietnam, China, UK, Europe, Other). ✅
action_items: LOW / OPTIONAL: Consider suppressing the 'None of the N selected products belong to <Manager>' toast (or downgrading it from warning to info) when zero matches occur — the spec explicitly requires a message here, but users cross-navigating with fully-mismatched selections may find the warning styling loud. Current behaviour is CORRECT per spec.
LOW: Pre-existing AdminDashboard 'unique key prop' React warning still present (carried over from prior iterations, not scope of this fix).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/supplier_sync.py bulk_update_product_tier_pricing() (lines 5754-5878): per-product override logic uses `'key' in product` — correctly distinguishes 'field absent → inherit top-level' from 'field explicitly null → treat as no-op' (since `product.get(k)` used only after `in` check). Solid.

ManagerPageShell.jsx cross-nav useEffect (lines 233-256): strips ?ids= from URL after applying — good, so a subsequent F5 relies on localStorage rather than re-applying the URL selection. Prevents double-toast.

useManagerBulk.js: localStorage write on every selection change and read-on-mount (guarded by storageKey) is clean; no `if(storageKey)` check missing at read time either. F5 persistence verified end-to-end.
PerProductOverridesPanel productKey helper matches the shape ManagerPageShell uses when merging overrides into the PUT payload — no key-shape drift between the panel and the save path.
ManagerTabsBar.withSelection() correctly handles both hardcoded and custom-manager tabs — +N chip shown on both. selectionKeys prop optional so legacy callers unaffected.
ManagerPageShell.jsx now 828 lines — over the 700-line ceiling flagged in iteration 207. Consider extracting the Tier Pricing / Sale Labels onSave callbacks into a hook.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend test suite touches 3 pre-existing supplier_products for round-trip and restores originals in fixture teardown. Frontend Playwright test did NOT save any Tier/Sale modal — only opened the modals and typed into inputs (nothing persisted).

ManagerPageShell.jsx is now 828 lines — flag for refactor next pass. All existing tests from iteration_207 remain green (spot-checked cross-nav from supplier-products and F5 flow).
